notes: New layer, registered as part of a Context Librarian catalog freshness fix (backend-ci was failing because these 4 files existed on main unregistered). Not yet exercised by a real consumption pilot the way cross_layer_architecture was — confidence is lower than the other 6 layers for that reason, not because the classification itself is in doubt.

cmd_marketing.py is a direct command handler (cmd_update.py/cmd_decision.py style) — not a dispatcher tool and not routed through ActionGateway/ActionContract; it does not participate in the approvals layer's lifecycle.

marketing_brief_composer.py's compose_brief()/compose_production_handoff() are pure, deterministic, no-I/O functions — no AI call and no Airtable access happen in that module; callers (cmd_marketing.py) fetch data and call the AI/Airtable layer themselves.

Domain vocabulary drift is intentional: Marketing Demand's Demand Type field (recruitment/furniture_import/fiber_equipment/real_estate_listing/service) is a Marketing-owned enum selecting a DomainProfile, separate from identity.Domain's canonical business-domain values used by turn_coordinator/core_reasoning — see marketing_domain_profiles.py's own module docstring.

Registration-only pass (post-#611 catalog freshness correction): marketing_orchestrator.py (F23 M2 pull-only Marketing Demand status/next-step composition, mirrors decision_orchestrator.py's contract — no writes, no messaging, no new I/O) and tma-frontend/src/components/MarketingStatus.tsx (wired into App.tsx/api.ts/types.ts, the live TMA surface for the same M2 status data) were added to code_paths — both are real runtime sources for this layer that predated registration. domain_utils.py, also consumed by this layer via marketing_gateway.py, is intentionally NOT added here — it is cross-layer canonical vocabulary support, not owned by marketing; see decision.business_domain_vocabulary in canonical_boundaries.json.

OWNER DECISION (PR #651, BUG-164 owner-decision-queue resolution): marketing_fact_authority.py (STOP-classified by the Context Librarian -- 'unregistered source may change authority'), marketing_creative_templates.py, and marketing_creative_renderer.py registered under this existing layer -- owner explicitly confirmed no new layer is created. These three, added by PR #623 (BUG-164 PR1, merged) and wired live by PR #645 (BUG-164 PR2, merged, commit e9d1ca8), are a genuinely new authority boundary within this layer: marketing_fact_authority.py defines ProtectedFact/FactAuthority (CANONICAL/DETERMINISTIC/CANDIDATE) tiers over Marketing Demand fields; marketing_creative_templates.py is a closed template registry (allowed_combinations() per demand_type, Template Semantic Contract); marketing_creative_renderer.py's authority_filter_and_render() is the sole function that may turn an AI-proposed CreativeProposal into persisted Creative-idea text -- cmd_marketing.py's _create_demand_and_generate_ideas() calls all three but originates none of the authority logic itself, matching this layer's existing precedent (cmd_marketing.py as thin caller, not authority owner). This does not touch tool_registry.py or ActionGateway -- it governs marketing-copy text content only, never tool dispatch/execution eligibility. last_verified_commit set to e9d1ca8 (PR #645's merge commit, where this authority boundary went live).
